verdicts.reason: All rules hold: the program prints a quote with a file:line or Figma-variable locator and exits non-zero on absent, mismatched or raw-hex values; reliable matches the brief's 'reliable if read from the source file'; an empty set reports 'absent'; and checkRunnable false is honest because the compare program is not written.

A3 fails: the brief says 'Keep the list shorter than the system', but the done-when only checks pytest exit codes per pattern and never counts the ban list against the system, so that element appears only as a trigger precondition.
A3 fails: the brief says 'Same prompt, same component', but the done-when checks only listed versus unlisted counts and records and never reruns the same prompt to compare which component was chosen.

A3 fails: the brief says 'Spacing and type come from tokens', but the done-when infers this from a pixel diff against a template that it assumes renders tokens, so a literal spacing or type value that matches the token visually passes without any check of where the value came from.

All rules hold: the check is the brand CLI's exit code plus a failed rule id with no near-pass, the weak status does not exceed the brief's rating while the tool is absent, 'tool absent' is accepted as a result, and checkRunnable false is honest.
